The '''Bloxia system''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="EAOC" /> that was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Bloxian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Breaking Free" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bloxia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square I-7.<ref name="TEA" />
